evidence.quote: Get your API credentials from the dashboard. New accounts get a $1 trial credit, costs $0.002 per call

evidence.claim: Very broad API surface spanning many modules (SERP, keywords, backlinks, reviews, app data, merchant, etc.)
evidence.quote: The official DataForSEO MCP server registers roughly 90 tools across ten API modules, and every one of them calls a /live endpoint.

evidence.claim: Vendor ships and documents an official MCP server on its own site
evidence.quote: Learn how to connect DataForSEO APIs using our new MCP server and CLI connection method.

notes: Pay-as-you-go pricing (per-call fees) rather than a flat free tier, but signup is free and credentials are issued instantly with a $1 trial credit. Docs show an async task_post/tasks_ready/task_get pattern alongside synchronous /live endpoints. Official MCP server and CLI connection method are documented on dataforseo.com; numerous first-party integrations exist (Zapier, Make, n8n, Google Sheets, Postman).
